$comment: Test streams from the public TSDuck streams repository. Files are downloaded into .cache/streams/ and never committed. TSDuck: https://tsduck.io/streams/

atsc-473.description: ATSC 1.0 terrestrial capture (USA), PSIP tables and AC-3 audio

isdb-nhk.description: ISDB-T terrestrial capture (Japan), BIT and clear ARIB captions on main-service PID 0x0130 (A profile) and 1-seg PID 0x0587 (C profile)

isdb-aab.description: ISDB-T Akita capture (Japan), clear ARIB captions in the 1-seg data service (PID 0x0314) and CA-scrambled main-service captions

isdb-abs.description: ISDB-T Akita Broadcasting capture (Japan), 21 clear C-profile ARIB captions on the 1-seg data service

dvb-france-uhf33.description: French DVB-T multiplex (UHF 33), EIT, SDT, Teletext and subtitles

france-uhf30.description: French DVB-T multiplex (UHF 30) with 11 DVB bitmap subtitle streams (M6, W9, Arte, France 5, 6ter)

isdb-tb-204.description: Brazilian ISDB-Tb with 204-byte packet trailers and an IIP PID

uk-freeview-482.description: UK Freeview multiplex with Teletext and DVB subtitles

italy-mux1rai.description: Italian Rai mux (Sardinia), Teletext subtitle pages 777/778 on Rai 1/2/3/News 24; no DVB bitmap subtitles (0x59) signalled

france-dvbt2-uhd.description: French DVB-T2 multiplex with two UHD HEVC services

hotbird-mhp.description: Hot Bird 13E TS 6000 with two DVB-MHP object carousels on PIDs 0x1E9E/0x1E9F (BIOP directories and class files)
